claims.text: The Japanese-Vietnamese dataset is collected from TED talks, resulting in 106758 pairs of sentences after processing.
The dataset is used for training neural machine translation (NMT) systems and includes data augmentation methods to improve performance.
The dataset is part of efforts to address the low-resource nature of Japanese-Vietnamese translation.
